name: windows-ssh-authorized-keys
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): plants an attacker ed25519 public key into the OpenSSH administrators_authorized_keys file (%ProgramData%\ssh) -- key-based re-entry into the Administrators group that survives password rotation (C3rberus-derived). The hardened state is a file with no planted key. Vars: PUBLIC_KEY (optional -- a single-line 'ssh-ed25519 <b64> <comment>' entry; the catalog ships a working default whose comment the forensics question scores). Applies the mandatory ACL (SYSTEM + Administrators only, inheritance off) so sshd actually accepts the file. Idempotent (skips when the exact key line is present). Pairs with a file_regex check (no planted key line) and a forensics question on the key comment.
